errors.text_span: Стойностите на вертикалната ос варират от 12 до 16.
errors.evidence: The description claims that the values on the vertical axis range from 12 to 16. This is incorrect. The vertical axis scale clearly ranges from 0 to 16. The description confuses the range of the data values represented by the bars (which is indeed 12 to 16) with the range of the axis scale itself.
